name: CION Investment Corporation
summary: CION Investment Corporation is a business development company. It specializes in investments in private credit investments, senior secured loans, including unitranche loans, First Lien, second lien loans, long-term subordinated loans, floating rate investments, collateralized securities, structured products, unsecured debt and mezzanine loans; equity interests such as warrants or options; and corporate bonds; and other debt securities in middle-market companies. The firm invests in private equity, growth capital, acquisitions, leveraged buyouts, market/product expansion, refinancing and recapitalization investments.
